gloss: every time; at every opportunity; whenever (someone) opens their mouth

definitions.gloss: every time; at every opportunity (someone says something)
definitions.explanation: Literally "by the second word," used to criticize someone who brings up the same complaint, excuse, or catchphrase every time they speak — implying the remark comes almost as soon as they open their mouth.

examples.japanese: {二言目|ふたことめ}には「⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Every time (he opens his mouth), he says "I'm busy."

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二言目|ふたことめ}には⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧をする。
examples.english: My father brings up stories from the past every time he speaks.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二言目|ふたことめ}には「⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}れ→取る：00565_toru⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{怒鳴|どな}る→怒鳴る：05340_donaru⟧。
examples.english: That boss shouts "Take responsibility!" practically every time he opens his mouth.

notes:
{二言目|ふたことめ}には (literally "by the second word") introduces a complaint, excuse, or pet phrase that someone repeats almost every time they speak.

USAGE:
- Always followed by a quoted or reported remark, and always carries mild criticism or exasperation at the repetition.
- Common pattern: 〜⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二言目|ふたことめ}には「…」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧/⟦{怒鳴|どな}る→怒鳴る：05340_donaru⟧/⟦{愚痴|ぐち}る→愚痴る：09293_guchiru⟧ (~ says/shouts/complains "..." every time).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}けば→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: whenever (someone) opens their mouth — nearly synonymous, slightly more literary
- ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧: always — much more general, without the "repeats the same line" nuance
